metadata.provenance_note: Trait-region labels are Qwen activation-space trait-vector cosine enrichments. The trait matrix has mixed provenance and is not an independent psychological rating table.

quantile.label: Quantile bands
quantile.description: Five equal-count PC1 quantile bands crossed with within-band PC2 tertiles. This is the statistically stable default.
